replies.author: KojaCola
replies.body:
Hello there!

Thanks for making a map, it looks great but there are a few things I would like to see improve:

  • The monuments are connected to the spawn, which would cause defending easy and rushing difficult. 
  • More pictures would be nice to see some more of the detailed features of the map.
  • The islands are really skinny which makes it hard to rush without being knocked off. 
  • Just a tip... Use F1 or CTL F1 (if you use a mac) when taking pictures  :)
The map looks good, it just needs some improvement! Good job. 

(This is not an official response, this is just my opinion. Please expect an official response sometime in the near future!)

Furthermore, we placed the monuments there because if it was behind everything at the sides of spawn, gameplay would be very stale. Also, because Vior took the photo from very high in the air, the map looks very small and the islands appear small. They are not that bad. Furthermore, you can't complain about skinny islands when Luar is in rotations.

replies.author: Myv
replies.body:
Hello

The lanes are all a bit thin. Increasing their width by 3 or 4 blocks should do the job of addressing this problem.

The monuments are connected to the rest of the spawn lanes which will make rushing difficult. 

The back line is quite straight and the map itself also looks quite small.

It's a good start though! The block palette is good and quite unique in a way and it looks good.

replies.author: Milki
replies.body:
Lanes are a bit thin: They're about 6-8ish blocks wide, a little smaller than a few maps that were recently in rot (Rendezvous, Kollad, Nevran). I think it's ok, given that the monuments are at mid-back rather than fully back, and compensates for it by giving rushers a shorter path to mon.

Monuments connected to the back: It will make rushing difficult, but it's not terrible. It takes 10-15 sec from spawn to get there. I'm more concerned about the fact that defense has a 270 degree margin of firing-- they can hit rushers on 3 sides, which is especially bad for rushers. It might make for some interesting gameplay, though, and I would probably want to test it with teams of 8 or so before criticizing it.

Back line straight, map too small: I think the back line being straight fits the style somewhat, but that's just my opinion. I agree that it's a little small as a map; I think limiting team size to 16 or so will fix that issue.
